author: @FrankCurzio
text:
SpaceX's big weekend came in at half a win.

Starship's upper stage got caught by the tower's arms for the first time ever on Saturday. But the booster, the half that had already worked, blew up over the Gulf of Mexico on Friday.

The top half is the hard one. It comes home from orbit at the highest speed and heat. Fully reusable still needs BOTH halves though... and the next flight has to show it.

Morgan Stanley called a successful catch one of the most significant catalysts in SpaceX's nearly 25-year history and kept its $300 target. Wall Street sold this as a double catch. It got one.

The business still got stronger, mostly through cheaper launches for its own Starlink satellites.

I'm still avoiding the stock for the reasons I gave Friday (unlocks & Musk politics).

Anyone buying the celebration is paying full price for a catch that only half happened.

-

For anyone new here, I'm Frank. 30 years on Wall Street, and I post what's moving the market as it happens. Follow me @FrankCurzio for more.
